valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 252.37 percent a year from FY2023 (5.835e+07) to FY2025 (7.2448e+08), over 2 years
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 7.3126e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (https://www.egx.com.eg/en/CompanyDetails.aspx?ISIN=EGS697S1C015 (Listed shares; as of 24/09/2026); price 7.3 EGP)
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 7.3126e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (https://www.egx.com.eg/en/CompanyDetails.aspx?ISIN=EGS697S1C015 (Listed shares; as of 24/09/2026); price 7.3 EGP)
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 7.37, price over EPS 9.73); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: revenue is not on file or not positive for FY2025. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

derived.enterpriseValueBasis: market cap + borrowings - cash, both from the balance sheet for FY2025
